prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign-in after adoption consistently performed poorly across 2 tests and was stopped early due to worsening sign-in rates.
Adding home screen wait-time info (4 wins), adoption redesigns (2 wins), and finish redesigns (2 wins) were helpful across winning tests, though several tests in these categories showed no clear effect.
Changes to sign-in copy, sign-in hints, sign-in notifications, choose-path copy, and finish new-flow flows consistently showed no clear effect across 2 or more tests each.
Choose-path layout modifications consistently showed no clear effect or degraded performance across 4 tests.
Categories with only a single test (such as adoption incentives, adoption notifications, or finish notifications) still provide thin evidence.
Predictions consistently underestimated major winning tests while overestimating changes that yielded no clear effect or performed worse.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, incentive] sign_in_cloud_backup_incentive: Add a prominent cloud save badge and data protection promise to the sign_in screen. (why: 8 support emails cited missing or reset pets after signing in or re-installing. Explicit data backup promises address key user hesitation at sign_in.)
1: [adoption, wait_info] upload_photos_processing_wait_info: Enable live time estimates and stage progress notifications during custom photo upload processing. (why: Custom photo generation is error-prone (3 support emails) and user drop-off during adoption step is significant.)
2: [home, notification] waiting_desktop_readiness_notification: Add desktop readiness status notification and completion audio alert when rendering finishes. (why: Home wait time mean is 2336s (over 38 minutes), indicating many users switch windows and forget the app.)
3: [finish, new_flow] home_intro_desktop_command_flow: Add an interactive quick action component to home_intro allowing users to test pet reaction commands before closing setup. (why: Addresses post-onboarding confusion regarding how to talk to or hide the desktop pet.)
4: [adoption, layout] adoption_certificate_split_layout: Switch adoption_certificate to a split layout showing the signed certificate on the left and desktop launcher settings on the right. (why: Adoption step changes have produced high-performing test wins in previous iterations.)

scores.note: Sign-in loses 27.1% of users and has 8 support emails, but sign-in copy and incentive tweaks historically produce modest gains.
Wait-time info is a strong historical winner (+2.1% across 7 tests) and addresses photo processing drop-off and 3 support emails.
Targets extreme 38-minute average wait time on home, though step drop-off is already low (4.1%) and notification results are mixed.
Finish new_flow changes consistently showed no clear effect or degraded performance (-1.8% historically) and require release work.
Layout modifications consistently underperformed or degraded conversion across 4 tests (-1.7% average) and need screen layout reworks.
